title: Aktiebolagslag (2005:551)
source: Aktiebolagslag (2005:551), as amended up to SFS 2026:783: 8 kap. 24–26 §§ (board minutes) and 7 kap. 48–49 §§ (general meeting minutes).

rules.text: A board keeps minutes of every meeting and records every decision.
The minute-taker signs; the chair checks them unless the chair took them, and with several directors one more director the board picks checks them too.
A director or the CEO may have a dissent recorded.
Board minutes are numbered in sequence and kept securely.
Minutes of a general meeting give the date and place, every decision, the motions and the result of each vote, with the voting list attached.
The minute-taker signs the general meeting's minutes; the chair, when not the writer, and at least one checker the meeting chose check them.
General meeting minutes are available within two weeks and kept securely.
